mnemonic.meaning: 真 truly + 赤 red: truly red.
mnemonic.reading: "MAKKA!" Make a red mark. (まっか) The っ gives it a punch, like 真っ白.

examples.ja: 恥ずかしくて顔が真っ赤になった。
examples.en: My face went bright red with embarrassment.

items.note: 真っ赤な嘘 = a complete lie. 真っ青 (まっさお) = deep blue or pale.

mnemonic.meaning: 中 inside + 身 body: the body inside. What's in it.
mnemonic.reading: NAKA (inside) + MI (body, like 身): what's inside. (なかみ)

examples.ja: 箱の中身は何ですか。
examples.en: What's inside the box?

items.note: Also figurative: 話の中身 (the substance of a talk).

mnemonic.meaning: TONDEMONAI: "TON-s of DEMONs, no!" Something wildly beyond normal.

examples.ja: とんでもない値段の時計だ。
examples.en: That watch has an outrageous price.

items.note: Also a polite reply to thanks: とんでもないです = "not at all".

mnemonic.meaning: 殴 has 殳 (weapon/strike): a hand striking.
mnemonic.reading: "NA, GOOO-RU!" the boxer shouts, punching. (なぐる)

examples.ja: 彼はかっとなって相手を殴った。
examples.en: He lost his temper and punched the other man.

items.note: 叩く (たたく) is a lighter tap or knock. 殴る is a hard hit with a fist.

mnemonic.meaning: 正 correct + 体 body: the correct body, under the disguise.
mnemonic.reading: "SHOW, TAI!" Show me your true self. (しょうたい) 正 is しょう here, not せい.

examples.ja: ついに犯人の正体が分かった。
examples.en: At last we found out who the culprit really was.

items.note: 正体不明 = unknown identity.

mnemonic.meaning: 穏 has 禾 (grain) and 心 (heart): a heart at peace, like a calm field of grain.
mnemonic.reading: "ODA! YA-KA!" The calm captain ODA speaks quietly. (おだやか)

examples.ja: 今日は海が穏やかだ。
examples.en: The sea is calm today.

items.note: For weather, seas, people and moods. 穏やかな性格 = a gentle nature.

mnemonic.meaning: 驚 has 馬 (horse): a startled horse rearing up. Surprise.
mnemonic.reading: "ODORO-KI!" Your door opens and you're surprised. (おどろき)

examples.ja: 彼の合格は大きな驚きだった。
examples.en: His passing was a big surprise.

items.note: Noun form of 驚く (to be surprised).

mnemonic.meaning: KICHINTO: a KITCHEN kept neat, everything in its place.

examples.ja: 部屋をきちんと片付けなさい。
examples.en: Tidy your room properly.

items.note: Close to ちゃんと, but more about neatness and order.

mnemonic.meaning: 謎 = 言 (words) + 迷 (lost): words that get you lost. A riddle.
mnemonic.reading: "NAZO?" Not so clear, it's a mystery. (なぞ)

examples.ja: その事件は今でも謎のままだ。
examples.en: That incident is still a mystery.

items.note: 謎を解く = to solve a mystery.

mnemonic.meaning: 組 has 糸 (thread): threads crossed and put together.
mnemonic.reading: KUMU: "COO, MOO!" Two birds team up. (くむ) Same くみ as 組 (class, group), e.g. 一年二組 (いちねんにくみ); in 番組 it becomes ぐみ.

examples.ja: 彼は腕を組んで考えていた。
examples.en: He was thinking with his arms crossed.

items.note: 足を組む = to cross your legs. 〜と組む = to team up with.

mnemonic.meaning: 手 hand + 段 step: the steps your hand takes. A means to an end.
mnemonic.reading: SHU (hand, as in 手術) + DAN: "SHOE-DAN" steps you take. (しゅだん)

examples.ja: 目的のためなら手段を選ばない。
examples.en: He'll use any means to reach his goal.

items.note: 交通手段 = means of transport. 方法 is the general "method".

mnemonic.meaning: 呼 breathe out + 吸 breathe in: out and in. Breathing.
mnemonic.reading: "KO, KYU!" In, out. (こきゅう)

examples.ja: 深く呼吸して、落ち着いてください。
examples.en: Breathe deeply and calm down.

items.note: Also "rhythm" or "knack": 呼吸が合う (to be in sync).

mnemonic.meaning: 出来 came out + 事 thing: a thing that came about. An event.
mnemonic.reading: DEKI (from 出来る) + GOTO (thing): "DECK it, go to the event!" (できごと)

examples.ja: 今日の出来事を日記に書いた。
examples.en: I wrote about today's events in my diary.

items.note: 出来事 = anything that happens, big or small. 事件 = an incident (crime, scandal). イベント = an organised event.

mnemonic.meaning: 同 same + 様 manner: the same manner.
mnemonic.reading: "DOH, YOU!" You're the same as me. (どうよう) Careful: 動揺 below is also どうよう.

examples.ja: 今年も去年と同様に暑い。
examples.en: This year is hot, same as last year.

items.note: Formal. 同じ is everyday. 同様に = likewise.

mnemonic.meaning: 動 move + 揺 shake: inside, everything moves and shakes.
mnemonic.reading: DOUYOU: "DOH, YOU!" You're shaken. (どうよう) Same sound as 同様, but different kanji.

examples.ja: その知らせを聞いて、彼は動揺した。
examples.en: He was shaken when he heard the news.

items.note: Emotional, not physical. 同様 (same) is a different word with the same reading.

mnemonic.meaning: BONYARI: "BON, YAWN-ree": your mind wanders off in a blur.

examples.ja: 窓の外をぼんやり眺めていた。
examples.en: I was gazing blankly out the window.

items.note: For blurry sights and blank minds. ぼんやりする = to space out.

mnemonic.meaning: 掴 has 扌 (hand): a hand closing on something.
mnemonic.reading: "TSU, KAMU!" Something comes your way and you grab it. (つかむ)

examples.ja: 彼は私の腕を掴んだ。
examples.en: He grabbed my arm.

items.note: Also abstract: チャンスを掴む (seize a chance), 心を掴む (win someone's heart).

mnemonic.meaning: 沈 has 氵 (water): going down under the water.
mnemonic.reading: "SHIZU-MU!" The ship sinks while a cow moos. (しずむ)

examples.ja: 太陽が西に沈んだ。
examples.en: The sun set in the west.

items.note: 気分が沈む = to feel down. Transitive: 沈める (to sink something).

mnemonic.meaning: 覆 has 襾 (a lid on top): something put over to cover it.
mnemonic.reading: "OH, OO!" A blanket covers everything. (おおう)

examples.ja: 雪が町を覆った。
examples.en: Snow covered the town.

items.note: Often for big areas or hiding something: 顔を覆う (cover your face).

mnemonic.meaning: BUTSUKARU: "BUTT, CAR-RUns into it!" Bang, a collision.

examples.ja: 自転車が車にぶつかった。
examples.en: A bicycle ran into a car.

items.note: Also for problems: 問題にぶつかる (run into a problem). Transitive: ぶつける (Level 5).

mnemonic.meaning: 少 few, repeated: a little bit.
mnemonic.reading: "SHOW, SHOW!" Just a little show. (しょうしょう)

examples.ja: 少々お待ちください。
examples.en: Please wait a moment.

items.note: Polite version of 少し. Very common in shops and on the phone.

mnemonic.meaning: 調 investigate + 査 inspect: look into it carefully.
mnemonic.reading: "CHOU, SA!" (ちょうさ) The detective chews and says, "Let's investigate."

examples.ja: 事故の原因を調査している。
examples.en: They are investigating the cause of the accident.

items.note: 調べる is the everyday verb. 調査 is for formal studies and polls.

mnemonic.meaning: 満 has 氵 (water): water filling right to the top.
mnemonic.reading: "MICHI-RU!" Your cup fills while you sing "MICHI-RU, Michelle." (みちる)

examples.ja: 彼の顔は自信に満ちていた。
examples.en: His face was full of confidence.

items.note: Often 〜に満ちる / 満ちた: 希望に満ちた (full of hope). Formal and literary.

mnemonic.meaning: 男 man + 子 child: a male child.
mnemonic.reading: "DAN, SHE!" (だんし) Dan the boy meets a girl.

examples.ja: 男子学生は三十人いる。
examples.en: There are thirty male students.

items.note: 男子 / 女子 are used for students and sports teams: 男子トイレ (men's room).

mnemonic.meaning: MOSHI + MO: an extra "mo" makes the "if" stronger.

examples.ja: もしも宝くじが当たったら、何をする?
examples.en: If you won the lottery, what would you do?

items.note: Stronger, more dramatic もし. もしものとき = in an emergency.

mnemonic.meaning: 硬 has 石 (stone): hard as a stone.
mnemonic.reading: "KATA, EE!" The rock is hard, ouch. (かたい)

examples.ja: このパンは硬くて食べにくい。
examples.en: This bread is hard and difficult to eat.

items.note: Three kanji for かたい: 硬い (hard material), 固い (firm, solid), 堅い (steady, serious).

mnemonic.meaning: 願 has 頁 (head): something you hold in your head and hope for.
mnemonic.reading: "NEGAI!" (ねがい) A wish you never give away.

examples.ja: 私の願いは家族の健康です。
examples.en: My wish is for my family's health.

items.note: Noun from 願う. お願い = a favour, please.

mnemonic.meaning: 意 mind + 思 think: what your mind thinks you'll do.
mnemonic.reading: "EE, SHE!" (いし) She has a strong will.

examples.ja: 本人の意思を尊重する。
examples.en: We respect the person's own wishes.

items.note: 意思 = intention. 意志 (also いし) = willpower. Both are common.

mnemonic.meaning: MASU (to increase) twice: it increases and increases.

examples.ja: 雨がますます強くなってきた。
examples.en: The rain is getting heavier and heavier.

items.note: Usually with a change: ますます〜なる.

mnemonic.meaning: TAPPURI: "TAP, POUR-ee": you pour and pour until it's plenty.

examples.ja: 時間はたっぷりあるから、急がなくていい。
examples.en: We have plenty of time, so no need to hurry.

items.note: Generous amounts: たっぷり寝る, クリームたっぷりのケーキ.
